title: Development Task-Graph Proposal (Planning node output)
description: Wave 9 package-local schema (W9-A3) for the output of the plan-task-graph development node. The planner proposes an advisory decomposition: implementation work items, one required verification item per accepted AC, and integration targets matching the bound repositories. The proposal has NO execution authority until the kernel resolver resolve-task-graph validates lineage, coverage, repository bindings and acyclicity and materializes canonical tasks. Kernel-owned fields (graphHash, lineage hashes) are absent here — the planner never fills them.

implementationItems.description: Implementation work items. At least one per AC marked implementationRequired.

verificationItems.description: Exactly one required verification item for every accepted AC, regardless of implementationRequired.

integrationTargets.description: One per bound repository; targetBranch and expectedBaseCommit copied exactly from the development case.

key.description: Stable non-empty key, unique across both item arrays.

taskKind.description: Allowed semantic task kind, e.g. development.code or verification.ac.

projectRepositoryId.description: Bound repository id, or null only when the item genuinely owns no repository.

acceptanceCriterionIds.description: Accepted AC artifact ids this item satisfies/verifies. A verification item carries exactly one.

dependsOnKeys.description: Keys of other proposed items. Implementation items depend only on implementation items.
